body: const crumbs = matches.filter((m) => Boolean((m.handle as any)?.breadcrumb))
Pattern: breadcrumbs.description:
Breadcrumbs from the matched route tree: each route exports `handle.breadcrumb`, the layout reads them via `useMatches()`.
No central config to keep in sync — a route carries its own label.

Pattern: search with URL state.description:
Keep search state in the URL so it survives reloads and can be shared.
`replace: true` keeps each keystroke out of history; `defaultValue` (not `value`) leaves the input uncontrolled so typing stays smooth.

Pattern: pagination.description:
Page number lives in the query string, so every page is linkable and the Back button works.
Read it in the loader — the data is fetched before render, with no client-side loading state to manage.

Pattern: tab navigation.description:
Tabs as nested routes: each tab is a real URL, deep-linkable and back-button friendly.
Relative `to` values resolve against the parent route.
